shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone surface
horizontal register bands dividing the composition
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief figures organised into horizontal registers, and both include profile quadrupeds, but that is a very generic correspondence. A depicts long processions of naturalistically proportioned clothed human figures with staffs and led animals, while B shows schematic isolated animals (feline descending head-down, bird with outstretched wings, snake-like forms) and a row of abstract U/loop signs above a fringed band, with no human processional content at all.
